Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/bot_group_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 900. Every mutant must be caught. Each is caught by the case named in expect; the baseline runs the cases of the batch (AI38 and the shipped-plan pins AI9.5 and AI11.6) and the selftest of bot_arena. The last four mutants were added after an independent check of the first seventeen. Two more mutants of that check are left out as equivalent: can_defend without the 'holding' test, and without the 'carried_points' test (a carrier has both set, so each test alone does the work of the other).
